package com.a;

@NiagaraType
// Over-amperage alarm limit, shared by the three compressors. One limit for all 3
// compressors. 0 (default) = disabled.
// compressors. 0 (default) = disabled, same convention as the other limits.
@NiagaraProperty(name = "overAmpsLimit", type = "double", defaultValue = "0")
// Longer rationale goes first.
// Suction low limit in psig; 0 (default) disables it.
@NiagaraProperty(name = "suctionLowLimit", type = "double", defaultValue = "0")
// Discharge high limit in psig.
// @NiagaraProperty(name = "quoted") in a comment is no annotation
@NiagaraProperty(name = "dischargeHighLimit", type = "double", defaultValue = "0")
// Pressure fallback: when the transducer reads invalid
// Uses the switch instead.
@NiagaraProperty(name = "pressureFallback", type = "boolean", defaultValue = "true")
// Fan delay before the defrost heaters start
//
// Seconds; 0 disables it.
@NiagaraProperty(name = "fanDelay", type = "int", defaultValue = "0")
// Links:
//   Defrost.skipped  -> Room.defrostSkipped
//   Defrost.reason   -> Room.skipReason
@NiagaraProperty(name = "links", type = "int", defaultValue = "0")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "noComment", type = "int", defaultValue = "0")
